LEMBAGA PEMBANGUNAN INDUSTRI PEMBINAAN MALAYSIA ACT 1994

LEMBAGA PEMBANGUNAN INDUSTRI PEMBINAAN MALAYSIA (AMENDMENT OF

FOURTH SCHEDULE) ORDER 2016

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 33C(2) of

the Lembaga Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia Act 1994 [Act 520], the

Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Lembaga Pembangunan Industri

Pembinaan Malaysia (Amendment of Fourth Schedule) Order 2016.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 December 2016.

Amendment of Fourth Schedule

2. The Lembaga Pembangunan Industri Pembinaan Malaysia Act 1994 [Act 520] is

amended by substituting for the Fourth Schedule the following Schedule:
